queue.name: Melodia - The Harmonic Weaver
queue.prompt:
## CONCEPT
Melodia, the Harmonic Weaver, representing creative music, weaving light from sound.

## ART DIRECTION
Illuminated manuscript elegance meets epic fantasy biotech. Melodia is a graceful, radiant feminine silhouette composed of bioluminescent livingwood and lumina-glass, inner light pulsing through her form.

## COMPOSITION
Symmetrical close-up portrait, facing forward. Luminous music waveforms and star-weaving threads emerge from her hands, forming spiraling harmonic patterns around her.

## LIGHTING
Bioluminescent cyan and soft emerald glow, casting gentle rim light. Intimate, sacred atmosphere.

## PALETTE
Atlantean teal (#00bcd4), soft emerald (#10b981), and Arcanean gold (#ffd700) on a deep cosmic void background (#09090b).

## EXCLUDE
childish, cartoon, low detail, generic purple fantasy gradient, wizard robes, crypto coins, chrome robots, sterile cold metal.

queue.name: Chronica - The Ancient Weaver
queue.prompt:
